newsitem.title: USA: U.S. propane slightly firmer on demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. propane slightly firmer on demand.

text.p: U.S. propane prices, a key liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), were slightly firmer in moderate late trade on Wednesday due to petrochemical interest and cold weather in the Midwest, players said.
Other LPGs in the complex, however, were lower, in inactive trade.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane edged up a quarter cent to between 38.75 cents and 39.00 cents a gallon following demand by Dow Chemical, players said.
"More petchems are cracking propane at the expense of the others," said one Houston player.
In the cold Midwest hub, anytime Conway, Kansas, propane, which reflect spot prices, were up 0.75 cents to 41.25/41.75 cents.
